utility.notes: SMUD is a municipal (publicly-owned) electric utility. Elk Grove is confirmed as within SMUD's service territory (alongside the City of Sacramento, Citrus Heights, Rancho Cordova, and unincorporated Sacramento County) per PG&E's own documentation of which areas fall under other utilities within/adjacent to its territory.

value.name: Sacramento Municipal Utility District (SMUD)
value.notes: SMUD is a vertically-integrated municipal utility — it generates/procures and delivers its own power rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA, consistent with the pattern already established for the City of Sacramento this session.

permit_authority.value: City of Elk Grove Building Division
permit_authority.notes: elkgrove.gov returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session (the dedicated Residential Solar Photovoltaic Permits page, the SolarAPP+ streamlining page, and the Utility Providers page, which redirects to the same blocked host). This department name and page titles are confirmed via search-engine indexing, but the pages' specific content (eligibility, fees, timeline) could not be independently verified.

permit_url.notes: URL identified via search-engine indexing; elkgrove.gov returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session, so its content could not be independently read or verified.

interconnection_url.notes: SMUD's NEM rate schedule page is already established as an interconnection source for the City of Sacramento record this session, but was not re-cited here without directly confirming it applies identically for Elk Grove customers.

battery_programs.notes: The statewide SGIP program (administered by the CPUC-regulated IOUs) does not apply to SMUD customers, since SMUD is a municipal utility outside CPUC jurisdiction, consistent with the City of Sacramento record this session.
